subject.title: message tool: Feishu send action polluted by poll schema/guard prevents file send

question: Should ordinary `message.send` strip/sanitize all poll creation fields, or should the model-facing schema be action-scoped so send never exposes poll creation fields in the first place?
rationale: Current main intentionally allows metadata-only padding but still rejects content-bearing poll fields on `send`; choosing between strict poll intent, stripping, and action-scoped schemas changes the public model-facing tool contract.

options.title: Action-scope poll schema
options.body: Expose poll creation fields only for `action="poll"` or channel-specific poll tools so ordinary sends cannot be polluted by poll params.

options.title: Sanitize on send
options.body: Keep the unified schema but strip poll creation fields from `action="send"` before the guard and channel dispatch.

options.title: Keep strict content-field rejection
options.body: Treat non-empty poll question/options on `send` as real poll intent and require more live evidence before changing the contract further.

recommendation.title: Action-scope poll schema
recommendation.body: Expose poll creation fields only for `action="poll"` or channel-specific poll tools so ordinary sends cannot be polluted by poll params.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest history in the shared message-tool schema/action boundary and is the best available owner for the product-shape decision.
